title: Subhanaka – with its meaning
intro: With Subhanaka we glorify and praise Allah – especially at the start of every Salah.

learn.html: We glorify and praise Allah, the Most High, by reciting Subhanaka. We say it often, and especially at the start of every Salah.

learn.label: Subhanaka
learn.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
learn.tr: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa ta‘aalaa jadduka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruk!
learn.en: Glory be to You, my Allah, and all praise is Yours. Blessed is Your name, Your greatness is beyond reach, and there is no god but You!

items: Subhaanakallaahumma – Glory be to You, my Allah
wa bihamdika – and all praise is Yours
wa ta‘aalaa jadduka – Your greatness is beyond reach
wa laa ilaaha ghayruk – and there is no god but You

learn.html: Listen to it part by part: Subhanaka with the recording.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: We recite Subhanaka at the start of Salah, after the opening Allaahu akbar.
